name: TeamStarWolf - The Year 2025 in Intrusions
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. ATT&CK Enterprise techniques that the verified 2025 record supports: the CISA and partner advisories of the year (AA25-050A, AA25-071A, AA25-141A, AA25-141B, AA25-203A, AA25-239A, AA25-266A) and the 2025 updates to AA23-320A, AA23-352A and AA24-109A, the ATT&CK campaign records C0058 SharePoint ToolShell Exploitation and C0059 Salesforce Data Exfiltration, Google, Microsoft, Cisco Talos and the victims' own reports, and the ATT&CK objects the study binds. Revoked ids printed by the advisories are shown under their v20.0 successors from data/attack/superseded_by.jsonl. Each comment names source numbers from case-studies/CHRONICLE_2025.md. Scores: 100 an opened source or ATT&CK object prints the id, 70 the source describes the behavior and the study assigns the id, 40 Inferred (UNC6395's stolen Drift OAuth tokens).
